title: Retry loop resets profile with shutil.rmtree(ignore_errors=True); on Windows a partial delete leaves Default/ without the ledger, so every later attempt dies at once with "Legacy occupied or unproved profile refused" and the retry cannot recover
repro: Wrong-action case, py -m pytest test_sb_join_ownership.py -k "native_same_host and wrong-action" on a loaded box: 5/5 FAIL (87s,64s,40s,72s,494s); the 494 s run ended with main.out = managed-driver + fatal RuntimeError(Legacy occupied or unproved profile refused) and a profile holding Default/ and first_party_sets.db but no .lkb-ownership.json
fix_direction: Verify the profile is gone after rmtree (retry delete, or use a fresh profile directory per attempt and pass that path), and surface the real attempt-1 failure instead of the retry artifact
